headline: Burley: Raya injury won't stop Arsenal beating 'embarrassing' title rivals
description: Craig Burley thinks Arsenal's title rivals are too poor to take advantage of any injury to David Raya.

headline: Chelsea in 'fragile moment' as Caicedo injury adds to pain of Leeds rout
description: Another crisis might be unfolding at Chelsea, just a few months into Xabi Alonso's tenure.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool, Man United want Scalvini
description: A trio of Premier League giants are eyeing Atalanta defender Giorgio Scalvini. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Arsenal's near-collapse at Newcastle is a wake-up call
description: Arsenal could have moved eight points clear at the top of the Premier League. Instead, they completely lost their way in the second half vs. Newcastle.

headline: Does Newcastle draw raise first doubts over Arsenal's title defence?
description: James Olley discusses whether Arsenal's draw with Newcastle is an early warning sign in their title defence.

headline: David Raya to be assessed after leaving Arsenal's draw at Newcastle with injury
description: David Raya was forced off with an injury during Arsenal's 2-2 draw at Newcastle United on Saturday.
